decisions.quote: Our analysis has shown that, while the actual ORs from multiple studies may vary, the direction and approximate magnitude of the effect size remain the same. All variables with a statistically significant effect size in the original analysis remained significant, and therefore, clinical decisions made on the results in the regional study would be consistent with the national analyses.
decisions.reason: All originally significant risk-factor associations remained statistically significant in the same direction in both national replication analyses, and the authors conclude that the regional study's findings and clinical conclusions were confirmed. Under the codebook, differences in effect-size magnitude across datasets do not make a supported finding mixed.
